blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Carlos Yulo won his second gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after ruling the men’s gymnastics vault Friday. Yulo posted an average of 14.599 after two attempts, holding off Iran’s Mahdi Olfati, who settled for silver with 14.533. Olfati, who performed after Yulo, scored 15.100 on his first attempt but managed only 13.966 on his second. Ka Ki Ng of Hong Kong placed third with an average of 14.116.
